en.answer: The effect of <<10856>> only applies to those monsters that were face-up when its effect resolved. The effects of monsters Summoned later will not be negated.
en.question: Will monsters Summoned after the effect of <<10856>> resolved have their effects negated?
en.title: Will monsters Summoned after the effect of <<10856>> resolved have their effects negated?

ja.answer:
「<<10856>>」の効果は、その効果処理時に相手フィールド上に表側表示で存在していたモンスターにのみ適用されます。

効果処理後にフィールド上に出たモンスターの効果は無効にはなりません。
